original_title: Hydrogel-based delivery of extracellular vesicles for skin wound healing: design strategies, therapeutic mechanisms, and translational perspectives.
title: A hydrogel to keep extracellular vesicles where the wound actually is
blurb: A review of hydrogel carriers for delivering extracellular vesicles to skin wounds, covering how they're designed, what they're supposed to be doing therapeutically, and how close any of it is to actual translation.

original_title: Electronic and Steric Effects on the Photoswitching and Thermal Relaxation of Ortho ‐Substituted Pyrazole Azo Phthalimides
title: One CF3 group moves your photoswitch from UV to green light
blurb: Four ortho-substituted phthalimide-azopyrazole switches (CH3, CF3, tert-Bu, Ph) show that swapping in CF3 alone pushes E to Z photoisomerization out to 530 nm, while the rest still need 370 nm. The attainable Z-rich states barely budge across the set, so what you're buying is wavelength control, not better switching.

original_title: Acetate-Enabled Selective Electrochemical Deuterolysis of Propargylic Carbonates
title: D2O as your deuterium source, no exotic reagents required
blurb: A nickel-electrocatalyzed platform converts propargylic carbonates into deuterated allenes using plain D2O as the deuterium source, with acetate steering the selectivity. It covers 1,3-dialkyl allenes, the kind that actually turn up in nature, with excellent isotopic incorporation, useful given how fiddly selective deuteration usually is.

original_title: Novel Gram-negative bacteria hydrogel radiation dosimeters: Water equivalence and comparison with Gram-positive bacterial dosimeter
title: Bacteria as radiation dosimeters, now with a Gram-negative option
blurb: A hydrogel dosimeter built around Gram-negative bacteria, checked for water equivalence and compared against an existing Gram-positive version. Niche, but dosimetry is always hunting for cheap water-equivalent standins, and bacteria are cheaper than most.

original_title: Subnanometer Ni@Fe Catalysts Enable High-Performance and Stable Oxygen Evolution of WO3 Photoanodes
title: Subnanometer Ni@Fe coating pushes WO3 photoanodes to a record photocurrent
blurb: Trimesic acid pins subnanometer Ni@Fe hydroxide clusters onto nanoporous WO3, and the resulting photoanode hits a record ~2.4 mA/cm² at 1.23 V RHE under full sun, with notably better stability than bare WO3. The precise subnanometer placement is the actual trick, not just piling on more NiFe.

original_title: Electrochemically Driven Phenazine Autoxidation Coupled With Supported Liquid Membrane Technology for Hydrogen Peroxide Production
title: Keeping H2O2 production and decomposition from undoing each other
blurb: Direct electrosynthesis of H2O2 usually self-destructs because the product forms and decomposes right at the same electrode interface. This pairs electrochemically driven phenazine autoxidation with a supported liquid membrane to physically separate the two steps, aimed at making electrified H2O2 production scalable rather than just a neat lab cell.

original_title: Flexible‐Ligand Rigidification Enables Anti‐Thermal‐Quenching Emission and Cryogenic Afterglow in Antimony‐Based Hybrid Bimetallic Halides
title: Freezing a floppy ligand to stop luminescence from dying when it's hot
blurb: Flexible urea ligands are usually why hybrid halide emitters fade at higher temperature. Rigidify them inside zero-dimensional antimony-based bimetallic chlorides like [RE(DEU)6]SbCl6 and the self-trapped-exciton emission resists thermal quenching, with cryogenic afterglow as a bonus across a whole family of rare-earth variants.

original_title: Beyond Push–Pull Chromophores: Unlocking the Synthetic Potential of Formal [2+2] CA‐RE for Quinolone Annulation
title: An old push-pull dye reaction repurposed to build quinolines metal-free
blurb: The CA-RE cycloaddition-retroelectrocyclization reaction normally just makes push-pull chromophores. Here they intercept its intermediate with an intramolecular nucleophilic cyclization instead, turning o-aminophenyl alkynes and dicyanoalkenes into dicyanovinyl dihydroquinolines without a metal catalyst in sight.

original_title: Rh(III)-Catalyzed Annulation of Enaminones with Sulfoxonium Ylides: Access to Isoquinolines and Benzo[ de ]chromenes
title: Rh(III) annulation finds a different reason for its site selectivity
blurb: Enaminones plus sulfoxonium ylides give isoquinolines under Cp*Rh catalysis with AgOAc and PivOH, moderate to excellent yields, nothing shocking there. The interesting bit is the proposed mechanism: site selectivity looks driven by Lewis acid-enaminone interactions rather than the usual carbonyl-directed C-H activation.

original_title: PSMA Biology Through the Clinical Lens: Implications for Radioligand Therapy of Prostate Cancer with [(177)Lu]Lu-PSMA-617.
title: What PSMA biology actually buys you with Lu-177-PSMA-617
blurb: A clinical review tying PSMA biology back to how [177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 performs as radioligand therapy in prostate cancer. No new data, just the framework connecting the receptor science to what shows up in patients.

original_title: Reprogramming Stereocontrol Through Progressive Substrate Reorganization in Artificial Triplet Photoenzymes
title: Tuning an artificial photoenzyme by reorganizing the substrate, not the photosensitizer
blurb: Artificial triplet photoenzymes usually have no real link between where the photosensitizer sits and how the substrate is held, which makes stereocontrol a crapshoot. Crystallography, kinetics, simulation, and protein engineering trace the enantioselectivity of TPe4.0_FBpA's [2+2] cycloaddition to how tightly its cavity organizes the indole substrate, and remodeling that pocket step by step is what actually dials in the selectivity.

original_title: Mechanistic Characterization of a Multiproduct Sesquiterpene Synthase for Triquinanes and Quadranes from Streptomyces pathocidini
title: One terpene synthase, a whole pile of triquinanes and quadranes
blurb: Genome mining turned up a sesquiterpene synthase from Streptomyces pathocidini that refuses to commit to a single product. Isotope labeling and DFT work out the branching cyclization mechanism, and site-directed mutagenesis pulls out four more products, one of which the wild-type enzyme was already making in trace amounts.

original_title: Unraveling the Importance of Surface Hydrogen Diffusion in Photocatalysis by Isotope Probing
title: Hydrogen evolution's hidden bottleneck might just be diffusion
blurb: Using a well-defined Pt/TiO2(110) photocatalyst, time-resolved mass spec, and methanol isotopologues to trace where each hydrogen atom actually comes from, they find surface hydrogen diffusion is a real, previously overlooked limit on photocatalytic hydrogen evolution, not just the usual suspects.

original_title: Framework Deuteration Regulates Excited-State Dynamics and H2O2 Release in Covalent Organic Framework Photocatalysis
title: Swapping H for D in a COF boosts its H2O2 output by 80%
blurb: Same framework, same crystallinity, porosity, and ground-state electronics, just deuterated. D-TpPa makes H2O2 1.8x faster than H-TpPa in pure water under O2, and the spectroscopy points to weaker exciton-phonon coupling as the reason, a clean isotope effect with nothing else to blame it on.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Using All Probes Plasmids to Lower the Barrier for Quantifying Single-mRNA Translation Dynamics in Live Cells.
title: A plasmid kit for watching single mRNAs get translated live
blurb: A methods paper on "all probes" plasmids meant to make imaging single-mRNA translation dynamics in live cells easier to set up, lowering the barrier to entry rather than changing what's measured.

original_title: Subtype-Specific Enrichment of HER2-Positive Extracellular Vesicles Enables Metabolomic Profiling for Breast Cancer Liquid Biopsy
title: Fishing HER2-positive exosomes out of blood for a metabolomics liquid biopsy
blurb: Liquid biopsy EV work usually nets a mixed bag of vesicles that muddies the mass spec. Phage display turned up HER2-targeting peptides, built into a magnetic bead platform (SA@HER2-2-MPMs) that selectively pulls out HER2-positive extracellular vesicles, clean enough as a subpopulation to actually run LC-MS/MS metabolomics on for breast cancer.

original_title: Process Development of ABBV-576: A C2 Corrector for the Treatment of Cystic Fibrosis
title: A second-generation route for ABBV-576, oxidation step included
blurb: Process chemists rebuilding the manufacturing route for this CFTR C2 corrector after the first phase I batch exposed its weak points. The new sequence runs a branch-selective Mizoroki-Heck, a Sharpless asymmetric dihydroxylation/cyclization, then an alcohol-to-acid oxidation on a substrate that would rather fall apart than oxidize, capped with the amide coupling that forges the actual drug. This is the unglamorous part of drug development that decides whether phase I happens at all.

original_title: Tau positron emission tomography harmonization using the CenTauR approach: General conversion equations, relevant cut-points, and external validation.
title: A conversion scale so tau PET scans from different trackers actually agree
blurb: The CenTauR approach gives tau PET its own harmonization scheme, with conversion equations and cutpoints checked against an external dataset so results from different tracers and pipelines can be compared on one scale, the way Centiloid did for amyloid.

original_title: Sc(OTf)3-Catalyzed Reaction of Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes with Isatins toward Cyclobutene–Indolinone Scaffolds Bearing Contiguous Stereocenters
title: Bicyclobutanes meet isatins and come out with two new stereocenters
blurb: Sc(OTf)3 opens up 1,3-disubstituted bicyclobutanes and adds them across isatins, building cyclobutene-indolinone scaffolds with two contiguous chiral centers under mild conditions. Yields run up to 84% with broad substrate tolerance, but the diastereoselectivity only hits 12:1 at best, so some of these batches won't separate cleanly.

original_title: Anion-Exchange Strategy for the Optimization of Cu2MnS2-xSe x Nanostructures toward Bifunctional Electrocatalysis in Alkaline Water Splitting
title: Swapping sulfur for selenium to tune a water-splitting catalyst
blurb: A hydrothermal anion-exchange series across Cu2MnS2-xSex, dialing selenium content from zero to full swap. More selenium distorts the lattice and shifts the electronics of the Cu-Mn framework, which the authors tie to better charge transport and more accessible active sites for both halves of alkaline water splitting.

original_title: Photochemical Generation and Spectroscopic Characterization of Parent 3‐Iminooxetane and 3‐Oxazoline From 3‐Azidooxetane
title: Freezing argon at 3 K to catch two oxetane imines nobody had pinned down
blurb: UV photolysis of 3-azidooxetane trapped in argon at 3 K burns off the azide and leaves two C3H5NO isomers, 3-iminooxetane and 3-oxazoline, identified by IR against anharmonic calculations and confirmed with deuterium labeling. Simple heterocyclic imines like these matter for prebiotic and astrochemical questions, and apparently the parent compounds had never actually been characterized before.

original_title: Electronic Modulation-Driven Dual Self-Reconstruction of a Nickel–Molybdenum Oxide Catalyst for Durable and Highly Efficient Anion-Exchange-Membrane Water Electrolysis
title: A nickel-molybdenum catalyst that rebuilds itself into two different jobs
blurb: Doping a nickel-molybdenum oxide precatalyst with iron and vanadium steers how it reconstructs in situ, so it settles into one stable active phase under hydrogen evolution conditions and a different one under oxygen evolution. The point is a single precatalyst that's durable and efficient on both electrodes of an anion-exchange-membrane electrolyzer, instead of needing two separate catalysts.

original_title: Inverse-IMPRESSION: A Graph-Based Platform for Molecular Structure Elucidation from Experimental NMR Spectroscopic Properties
title: Running NMR spectra backward to get the molecule out
blurb: Inverse-IMPRESSION takes experimental NMR parameters straight to a bonding network with a graph transformer, then cleans up the guess by stripping out shaky bonds and reassigning them, then runs a noise-augmented ensemble to generate candidate structures. Structure elucidation as a model you feed spectra into rather than a puzzle you solve by hand.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Applying plasma as an etching technique for CN-85 SSNTDs: Comparison study
title: Plasma etching put up against the usual method on CN-85 track detectors
blurb: A comparison study testing plasma etching as an alternative to chemical etching on CN-85 solid-state nuclear track detectors.

original_title: What Determines the Charge State Distribution of Proteins Electrosprayed from Non-Denaturing Solutions?
title: Protein ions keep shedding charge even after they've dried out
blurb: Electrospraying BSA or ovalbumin from ammonium acetate or triethylammonium formate into dry air and isolating a single charge state in under a millisecond shows the protein ion keeps losing charge by ion evaporation even once the solvent is gone and it's sitting there dry. That's a problem for the usual story that max charge is set by droplet size via Rayleigh's limit or small-ion evaporation while the solvent is still around.

original_title: A Study to Compare DB-1303/BNT323 Versus T-DM1 in Breast Cancer
title: DualityBio's HER2 ADC goes head to head with T-DM1
blurb: Phase 3, active but not recruiting: DB-1303/BNT323 tested against T-DM1, the established HER2 antibody-drug conjugate, in HER2-positive breast cancer. Sponsor is DualityBio, and beating T-DM1 head-to-head rather than just adding another option is the actual bar here.
